comments.note: Corrected file-header comment: stated '26 test cases' but 31 tests are implemented and verified. Updated to '31 test cases' to match reality. Non-behavioral — no test logic changed.

Removed unused 'ApiError' import from the import block. All error-path assertions use .rejects.toMatchObject({ code: '...' }) or .rejects.toThrow() — ApiError was never referenced in any assertion. Removing it eliminates a dead import that could confuse future readers into thinking instanceof checks are in play.

The identity-move rejection test (moveInsight same-repo → same-repo) uses a hard-coded id of 1 with no seeded fixture. The test passes because moveInsight's same-name guard fires before the store lookup, but this is only valid as long as that ordering is preserved. The assertion uses the broad .rejects.toThrow() rather than checking a specific error code. Not blocking — behaviour is correct and covered — but worth noting for future maintainers if the implementation order ever changes.
